info.title: SOAbox UI API
info.description: API used by the SOAbox web interface. See docs/spec/v1-api.md.

AccountRef.description: The account a zone belongs to.

AccountView.description: An account with its zones and members.

CreatedKey.description: A created key with its secret, shown once.

ErrorBody.description: The standard error body for `/v1` and `/auth`.

detail.description: Human-readable message, safe to show to a user.

LocalLogin.description: Whether local accounts may sign in while OIDC is configured.

Me.description: The signed-in user, their CSRF token, and permissions.

MeUser.description: Profile fields of the signed-in user.

NewOidcUser.description: What happens to a new OIDC user.

OidcSettings.description: The provider settings as an Admin sees them. The secret is never included.

source.description: Where the settings in force come from.

enabled.description: True when single sign-on is offered on the sign-in page.

client_secret_set.description: True when a client secret is stored. The value is never returned.

redirect_uri.description: The callback URL to register with the provider.

client_secret.description: A new client secret. Omit or leave empty to keep the stored one.

OidcSource.description: Where the active provider settings come from.

Permissions.description: What a user may do, for the UI.

ProfileUpdate.description: Profile fields a user may change.

SetPassword.description: A new password for a user.

Settings.description: All settings. See the design's settings table.

SettingsPatch.description: A partial update. Missing fields are unchanged.

TemplateRecord.description: One record in a template. `name` is relative: `@` or a label.

TotpDisable.description: A TOTP code and the current password, to turn two-factor sign-in off.

TotpSetup.description: A new TOTP secret to show the user before enabling it.

account_id.description: `null` removes the zone from its account. Omit to leave unchanged.

allowed_record_types.description: Record types the editor may offer in this zone, from settings.
